source: Supernote Manta (A5X2), adb device SN100D20051174, system apps under /system_ext/app, pulled with adb pull, read with aapt2 dump badging and aapt2 dump xmltree, 2026-11-25 (#271)

vector.from: launcher icons that are vector drawables: Settings (com.ratta.settings res/sn1.xml), To-Do (supernote.task res/lO.xml), Calendar (supernote.calendar res/-I.xml), Email (supernote.email res/qT.xml), Digest (supernote.knowledge res/Rs.xml)

bitmap.from: launcher icons that are bitmaps: Note (supernote.note res/vD.png) and Document (supernote.document res/A_.png), 64 x 64 grey with alpha, measured on the pixels

exception: InkHub (res/vx.xml) is a filled black vector; it is the one native icon that is not an outline and is not followed

plugin.note: Plugin icons are 96 x 96 PNGs; the tablet scales a lasso row to 60 px (docs/supernote.md). 96 px is the native 48 dp vector at the tablet's 2x density, so the strokes are 8 px and the outline stays within 4 to 92 px.
